answer: Random beacon audits block bulk fakes. Each agent posts a $40 bond and one device, then faces a bridge check: at a random moment it must prove live control within 10 minutes, signing with its own plume pen key. Passing earns a violet badge; three misses freeze the bond. Running 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 devices and $40,000 in bonds plus staff for 1,000 checks, against $3,000 in rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
